title: The School Bus That Comes At Midnight (Part 1) #shorts #horror
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story from Creepyville. What would you do? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Imagine you miss the school bus every single morning.
Your teacher gives you one last warning. "Be on time tomorrow. Or else."
So tonight, you set five alarms. You sleep in your uniform.
At midnight, a horn honks outside.
It's the yellow school bus. Engine running. Door open.
"Let's go!" the driver calls. "You don't want to be late."
You're half asleep. It's the school bus. You get on.
Every seat is full of kids from your class.
But nobody talks. Nobody looks at their phone. They all stare straight ahead.
You sit next to your best friend. "Why are we going to school at midnight?"
He doesn't answer. He just smiles, and keeps smiling.
The bus drives past the school. It keeps going.
Past the town square. Past the last street lamp. Into the forest.
You look at the driver in the mirror.
*He has no eyes. Just a big, kind, smiling mouth. "Almost there," he says.
Part two is coming next. Follow, so you don't miss it.
